2025-05-06.riddle: I’m black and white and read all over, Sometimes folded, sometimes spread like a cover. I bring you stories of world and town— What am I?
2025-05-06.hint: I deliver daily headlines, but you can’t watch me—I’m meant to be read.

2025-05-07.riddle: I don't have eyes, but once I did see. Once I had throughts, but now I'm white and empty. What am I?
2025-05-07.hint: I used to be part of something living,  but now I sit quietly in museums or science labs.
